description: This file defines an internal class `InvokeDispatcher` responsible for dispatching various commands related to device functionalities (like camera, location, SMS, contacts, etc.) within an Android application. It includes methods for handling invocation requests, command validation, and error handling, and references multiple protocol and handler classes.

classes.name: InvokeDispatcher
classes.description: A dispatcher class that handles invocation commands by routing them to appropriate handlers and managing command validation, availability checks, and response generation.

methods.name: handleInvoke
methods.description: Dispatches incoming command requests to the appropriate handler based on command name, with validation and error handling.

methods.name: withReadyA2ui
methods.description: Ensures A2UI is ready before executing a block of code, managing host URL resolution and reachability.

methods.name: withCanvasAvailable
methods.description: Executes a block of code with try-catch to handle canvas unavailability.

methods.name: availabilityError
methods.description: Checks and returns error if specified feature or resource is unavailable or disabled.
